name: AsciiDoc Files
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
HTML export no longer overwrites an HTML file that the plugin did not write.
A link with a bad percent escape no longer throws.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
HTML export (Pro) no longer overwrites an HTML file that the plugin did not create.
A link or image path with a stray % sign no longer causes an error.
tip: Hold Ctrl or Cmd as you click a cross reference to open its target in a new tab.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. AsciiDoc Files is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for keeping your AsciiDoc files in Obsidian.
